name: Data.roundUp_mem_Icc
summary: roundUp(D, F) = N₁(D)·⌈F/N₁(D)⌉₊ lies between F and F + N₁(D) because F/N₁(D) ≤ ⌈F/N₁(D)⌉₊ < F/N₁(D) + 1 for F ≥ 0 (F > 0 by the lower bound).

steps.claim: Unfolding roundUp(D, F) = N₁(D)·⌈F/N₁(D)⌉₊, the claim is F ≤ N₁(D)·⌈F/N₁(D)⌉₊ ≤ F + N₁(D). Since F > 0 (HasLogBound.pos from exp(l) ≤ F), ⌈F/N₁(D)⌉₊ < F/N₁(D) + 1 bounds the upper side and F/N₁(D) ≤ ⌈F/N₁(D)⌉₊ the lower side; it remains to show F ≤ N₁(D)·(F/N₁(D)) and N₁(D)·(F/N₁(D) + 1) ≤ F + N₁(D).
N₁(D)·(F/N₁(D) + 1) = F + N₁(D) and N₁(D)·(F/N₁(D)) = F, because N₁(D) ≠ 0.
